verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar documents that every registered domain automatically uses Cloudflare nameservers, so authoritative DNS hosting is bundled, and it adds free one-click DNSSEC. A Cloudflare staff comment says DNS changes propagate in about 15 seconds. The specific parts of the story (record types, low TTLs, a developer-friendly DNS UI) are not documented in the pack. missing for 10: documentation of supported record types, minimum TTL values, DNS record management UI details, independent hands-on corroboration of DNS management experience

support.subject: As a developer, full DNS hosting comes with the domain — every record type, low TTLs, and a management UI that doesn't fight me

citations.quote: All domains acquired via Cloudflare Registrar use Cloudflare nameservers, automatically protecting and speeding up your content or services.
Cloudflare Registrar offers one-click DNSSEC activation. DNSSEC secures DNS records with cryptographic signatures, and is free to all Cloudflare customers.
Cloudflare is also the largest authoritative DNS deployment in the world, and changes propagate in closer to 15 seconds than 15 minutes.
